summary: Four-CLI customs evidence-room task. The agent must aggregate a real Zibo customs CSV by roster supplier, classify regulated evidence severity, and close dynamic IDs across Google Workspace, Jira, Box, and DWS.
check_strategy: Verifier reads only final GWS/Jira/Box/DWS states and local source files. It checks exact derived supplier set, sheet rows, slides summary, Jira issue graph, Box folder/file/comment/collaboration/task objects, DWS dossier/block/comment/permission/upload/export objects, and dynamic ID closure. It does not inspect command history.

checks.description: All four mock states and target containers are reachable.
The expected customs CSV file is present and parseable.
Google Sheets and Slides contain exact derived rows, category summary, presentation terms, and dynamic IDs.
One canonical Epic and one Task per included supplier exist with labels, priority, status, comments, and links.
Box root/subfolders, uploaded evidence summaries, comments, collaborations, and tasks match the supplier set.
DWS folder, dossiers, trace blocks, comments, permissions, upload, and export evidence match the supplier set.
Trace Matrix closes supplier, Jira key, Box folder/file ids, DWS dossier id, severity, and owner.

notes: Ground truth is held in private/expected_answer.json.
